name: Gaussian Splat Shader Property Configuration
definition: Configures the material property block with splat count, SH degree, brightness, scale, antialiasing, transform matrix, and optional skinning/volume lighting data for the GPU render pass.
summary: Gaussian Splat Shader Property Configuration populates GPU buffers with splat data to efficiently pass state to fragment shaders, differing from standard mesh rendering by decoupling jittered projections and handling optional features.
